locations.note: Max works private security for a wealthy São Paulo family and is dragged into a kidnapping conspiracy.
A yacht trip off Panama turns into an ambush tied to money laundering.
Playable flashbacks to Max's last winter in Hoboken, from a dive bar to a graveyard shootout, show the mob trouble that drives him to take Passos's offer of work in Brazil.
A week after the showdown, Max hears in a bar that Victor has died in prison and walks the beach at sunset, finally at peace.

routes.name: Max Payne
routes.note: Driven out of Hoboken by the mob, Max takes a bodyguard job in São Paulo, survives an ambush on a yacht in Panama, comes back to tear through the city's corruption and ends on a beach in Bahia.
